messages.subject: MSstats for Spectronaut Statistical Power Analysis
parts:
Greetings everyone!

Thank you for this wonderful tool and this platform to assist with troubles!

I am attempting to analyse my data from Spectronaut and have come to a bump when using the "test.power" function. All other functions up until this point worked. The error I am receiving for "test.power" is as follows:

Error in `[.data.table`(var_component, , "GroupBySubject") : 
  column(s) not found: GroupBySubject

Could you please provide any assistance to overcome this error?

Your time and effort is greatly appreciated!

Kind regards,
Pavan

messages.subject: Re: MSstats for Spectronaut Statistical Power Analysis
parts:
Hi,
the element of groupComparison output is called FittedModel, not fittedmodel. Fixing that should make the code work just fine. Just a comment: "TMP" summarization option is really better than "linear" and we recommend using that.
Kind regards,
Mateusz
